tasks.step: Check operation of hydrant by flushing through the unit
Check that hydrant blanks are attached to the hydrant
Check hand wheels are not damaged. Replace if necessary
Check that all quick release assemblies are working

Remove blank plug and check that Inst. washer inside outlet is damaged or perished.
Replace if necessary. Replace blank plug.
Check hydrant and pipework for leaks. If leaks tighten the appropriate bolts or spindle securing nut. If required change spindle packing.
